algorithm: 32-sided convex cylinder triangle subtraction and sampled capsule segment distance, independent of Unity/FreeIVA implementation
limitations: Static calculation uses original mesh vertices and an independently implemented convex polygon subtraction. It does not execute FreeIVA MeshCutter2 or Unity PhysX.
Only the specified centerline routes are sampled. Entry/exit, gravity contact, ladders, seated spawn, scene loading and full cabin navigation remain in-game tests.
Capsule radial distance is reduced by 0.005m for the vertical segment sample spacing; radius=0.2m, total height=0.6m, centerline offsets y+-0.1m.
All movable crewDoor geometry is excluded from open-door scans; it must be controlled by FreeIvaHatch and excluded from static Mk33Shell.
